title: Strict completion units under section-action equivalence and pro-étale restriction
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $F/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $A=\mathcal O_F$ with its induced $\ell$-adic norm topology, and a uniformizer $\pi$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For a scheme $T$, put $B_T=p_T^*\underline A$ and $k_{n,T}=(A/\pi^n)_T$ for $n\ge1$. Use the small pro-étale sites and universes of [def-weil-size-convention] and the ordinary unbounded derived module categories [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. Write $C_T(K)=R\varprojlim_{n\ge1}\operatorname{Res}_n(K\otimes^L_{B_T}k_{n,T})$ and $c_{T,K}:K\to C_T(K)$ for the specified strict-tower completion unit [sk-def-pe-derived-completion, lem-pe-completion-triangle-comparison].
Let $E_T$ denote the section-action equivalence from internal $B_T$-module objects to sheaves of modules over its section-ring sheaf, and also its termwise derived equivalence [lem-sfb-module-object-ringed-site-derived-comparison, lem-pe-internal-section-tensor-comparison]. This equivalence identifies cohomology, finite constant scalar local models, the strict derived reduction towers, their quotient transition maps, and their augmentations; its product comparisons induce a natural isomorphism $E_TC_T(K)\simeq C_T(E_TK)$ carrying $E_T(c_{T,K})$ to $c_{T,E_TK}$.
Let $h:T\to W$ be either a locally closed immersion (a closed immersion followed by an open immersion), a pro-étale site object, or a finite composite of such arrows. Identify inverse-image coefficient rings by the canonical maps $h^*B_W\simeq B_T$ and $h^*k_{n,W}\simeq k_{n,T}$. In these coordinates inverse image is exact, preserves products, and has natural isomorphisms
$$h^*(K\otimes^L_{B_W}k_{n,W})\simeq h^*K\otimes^L_{B_T}k_{n,T},\qquad h^*C_W(K)\simeq C_T(h^*K).$$
They commute with quotient transitions and carry $h^*c_{W,K}$ to $c_{T,h^*K}$. For the strict cone model $D_n(M)=\operatorname{Cone}(\pi^n:M\to M)$, this compatibility includes the transition $(x,y)\mapsto(x,\pi y)$, the augmentation $m\mapsto(m,0)$, the Roos map $1-T$, and the completion augmentation $m\mapsto(((m,0))_n,0)$ [lem-pe-principal-reduction-cone-calculus, lem-pe-roos-cone-calculus]. No Noetherianity or invertibility hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Choose the canonical integral presentations from strictIntegralCompletionPresentation. Prove finite constant local-model equivalence by strictCompletionFiniteConstantModels. For each scheme, construct a section scalar presentation, the actual section quotient tower B and its structure map iota. Obtain H, HM and the normalized TensorComparison from the existing module-object/ringed-site theorem; strictSectionPrincipalQuotientModels supplies the remaining normalized quotient models and augmented completion. Apply strictScalarCompletionFunctorComparison to the section equivalence, using its scalar equation and its preserved products. For a morphism in the allowed multiplicative closure, strictCompletionRestrictionLimits gives all coefficient-sized limits. Shrink to countable products on complexes, use strictIntegralScalarPullback for the scalar equation, and apply the same complete cone/Roos comparison theorem. All transitions, coordinate and unit equations are fields of that Comparison.
